text:
maria (PM): quick check — i pushed the latest roles-matrix mock to figma, want eyes on the invite affordance and audit nav before i hand off to eng
kevin.design: looking now. primary concern is visual weight — the invite CTA feels as heavy as the role chips, pulls attention away from the matrix
aria-ux: agreed. my proposal: soften CTA color to token 'accent-quiet' + add a subtle chevron to indicate a modal, so users don't confuse it for a persistent row action
ajay (eng): that sounds fine. just flagging we should avoid adding extra DOM complexity for screen readers — prefer aria-expanded on the row instead of an extra button when possible
maria (PM): good call. also debating the SSO toggle label: currently "SSO required" vs "Single sign-on enforced" — which is clearer for admins? suggestions?
kevin.design: "SSO required" reads like a boolean (on/off). "Enforce SSO" is an action. i'd go with "Require SSO for this org" as inline helper copy, short label still "SSO required"
aria-ux: i like label+help pattern. label: "SSO required" help: "All new invitees must sign in via your SSO provider." keeps the toggle compact and accessible
ajay (eng): implementation note: aria-describedby should point to the helper id so screen readers get the extra context
sam-sre: small ops note — when SSO is toggled on, we should show a transient banner linking to the audit log filter with prefilled "sso_change" events. Otherwise it's hard to trace who flipped it
maria (PM): yes — product wants that breadcrumb. on the audit nav itself, the current design has nested tabs + a left rail. users reported trouble finding invite events. i sketched a persistent filter chip area at top of the log
kevin.design: show me the sketch
maria (PM): (paste) ```
[Audit log]
| Filters: [All] [Invites] [SSO] [Role changes] | search box |
-- event list --
``` 
aria-ux: that's much better. key accessibility nit: ensure filter chips are keyboard focusable, and pressing left/right moves between them (roving tabindex pattern). announce count when a filter is applied, e.g., "Invites filter applied, 24 results"
ajay (eng): roving tabindex is doable. backend will need a small endpoint change to return counts per filter — otherwise we'll be fetching full list then counting client-side
maria (PM): ok i'll add that to the ticket. another UX question: invite flow microcopy — current line is "Invite members by email" which seems generic; we want to surface role assignment before invite is sent
kevin.design: propose replacing with two-step inline: primary text "Invite by email" and a secondary line "Choose role before sending" with a small role dropdown inline
aria-ux: or collapse into a single flow where role pill is the first input — enter email, pick role (default contributor), send. makes it explicit. also add an info icon with tooltip: "Members inherit org-level roles unless overridden"
sam-sre: one more operational thing — invite emails include a deep link that expires after 7 days. we should surface expiry in the UI and in audit events so support can triage
maria (PM): agreed. copy suggestion: on invite confirmation modal use: "Invitation will expire in 7 days. You can resend later from the Members page." better than current terse text
kevin.design: small copy tweak: replace "Members page" with "Organization members" for clarity in nested orgs
ajay (eng): accessibility nit on the modal — ensure we trap focus on open and return focus to the invite CTA on close. also the role dropdown needs proper label for screen readers: aria-label="Role for new invitee"
aria-ux: also ensure contrast on the role pill text for the compact rows — some of the low-contrast tokens fail WCAG AA at small sizes
kevin.design: i'll adjust token palette and push a variant for compact table density
maria (PM): cross-check: buttons in compact rows — we currently have inline ellipsis menu + primary row actions. users want one-click role edit. can we make role pill itself editable-in-place?
ajay (eng): inline edit could work but must be keyboard-accessible: Enter to activate, Escape to cancel, Tab to move to next cell. We'll need a fallback for mobile where it opens a small sheet
sam-sre: regarding logs again — when role is edited via inline, emit an event type "role_inline_edit" with actor id and before/after role. that will make audit entries consistent
maria (PM): great. one last accessibility/regression ask from compliance: every audit-nav route must include a query param 'view=auditable' so we can run automated scrapers against exported pages. small change but important
ajay (eng): can do. will add route shim and keep backwards-compatible defaults
deploy-bot: deploy queued for canary after code review — summary: invite flow tweaks, SSO label + helper, roving tabindex on audit filters, inline role edit support, audit event types added
kevin.design: :thumbsup:
aria-ux: :eyes: I'll follow up with alt text for diagrams and the updated color tokens
maria (PM): thanks team — i'll open the main ticket and link the figma and acceptance criteria. please add any follow-ups as comments on the ticket
ajay (eng): will comment on technical assumptions
sam-sre: will add audit schema examples
maria (PM): done — https://redwood-internal/issue/PRJ-4122 — please review before EOD
